name: systemia-remote-ops
description: Use Systemia Remote Ops when a founder, operator, buyer or seller wants to test a consequential business move before committing money, payroll, leases, contracts or ownership changes. It models startup, pricing, expansion, staffing, product/service, acquisition, partnership and capital-purchase scenarios using explicit caller-supplied assumptions while keeping modeled outputs separate from observed results.

interface.shortDescription: Simulate startup, pricing, expansion, hiring, acquisition and other business decisions before acting
interface.longDescription: Use Systemia Remote Ops when a founder, operator, buyer or seller wants to test a consequential business move before committing money, payroll, leases, contracts or ownership changes. It models startup, pricing, expansion, staffing, product/service, acquisition, partnership and capital-purchase scenarios using explicit caller-supplied assumptions while keeping modeled outputs separate from observed results.
defaultPrompt: I am considering a consequential business decision. Help me model the baseline, change the assumptions, compare scenarios, and keep modeled results clearly separated from observed reality before I act.
